items.title: FAA Technician Only Unlocked The Door: Inside The Oversight Gap Behind The Nationwide Ground Stop
items.why: Ground stops can strand cardholders, so travel-disruption benefits stay relevant, but this is not a partnership lever.
items.summary_ai: CNN reports an FAA technician only unlocked the door for an L3Harris contractor, tied to a March 2025 policy that cut maintenance oversight.
items.take: Ground stops can strand cardholders, so travel-disruption benefits stay relevant, but this is not a partnership lever.
